svg.title: Pest-monitoring and spot-spraying robot
svg.desc: System block diagram showing USB, private Wi-Fi, UART, sensor signals, actuator outputs and the water path. The left column is the refill station, the centre the car MSP430 and the right the Arduino Uno and Zumo Shield.
svg.text: The laptop confirms a blue pest marker. The car controls the tracks and spray pump, and the dock controls refilling.
Grants motion and times the spray
Follows the line and drives the tracks
Dock P2.4 · low when the magnet is present
P3.2 sends TRIG · divided ECHO enters P2.7
P6.0 / ADC A0 · analog water-level reading
D4, A3, D11, A0, A2, D5 · D2 emitters
I²C (SDA/SCL) · tilt for the flip alarm
Uno link · P3.3 TX → D6 RX · D13 TX → divider → P3.4 RX
* The coordinated firmware uses the laptop for stop requests and refill permits. The handover firmware runs the dock refill locally.
The robot uses water in the pest-marker demonstration. Each pump has a separate motor supply.
